x: …ust still be in 34th position for us to win and so we waited for what seemed an eternity as the finishers came in, 28th Stroud of Poly, 29th Hart of the Beagles, 30th Rutland, 31st Frazer (our 8th “ A ” Team man) 32nd Everard, Beagles, if the next man was Longshaw of Highgate it would be a draw, and…

As a point of interest we had three members in the first twelve in the Civil Service Championship, viz: Baulch, Stroud and Hallowell. I would also like to congratulate Jack Brown on notching yet another championship win over the country.

Newell and Stroud were 4th. and 7th. respectively in the 1500 metres, Newell's time being 3m.58s. Alan Jackson and Dudley Gordon were finalists in the 400m. and a welcome entry in the 400m. hurdles was Brian Coleman.
